bibl.title: Who's wealthier? An estimation of the annual coin production of the Seleucids and the Ptolemies.
bibl.seg: Panagiotis P. Iossif, Who's wealthier? An estimation of the annual coin production of the Seleucids and the Ptolemies.
bibl.note: The average annual fresh coin supplies of the two richest Hellenistic states are put into perspective and comparison using, for the Seleucid empire, a new quantitative method based on the extrapolation of data recorded in the so-called SHD (Seleucid Hoard Database), a large database analyzing all known hoards containing at least one Seleucid coin. The usefulness of the SHD data - and the extrapolations it makes possible - is illustrated by a comparison between the coin production of the Seleucids and the Ptolemies, whereby for the latter, the quantitative data of the extensive die study by Julien Olivier is used. The results show that the two major Hellenistic economies did not differ that much in terms of the sizes of the annual supply of new coins for the circulation in their realms.
